decisions.reason: A certified HVAC gasketed plate line close to the core offer costs little to hold and stays a useful option in a growing efficiency-driven market, though the lack of website visibility since 2019 leaves some uncertainty.
The box cooler line showed early signs of strong market share in marine water cooling, so the option appears to be paying off and merits continued commitment.
The marine cooling unit complements the successful box cooler line and is cheap to maintain, so abandoning it without negative evidence would destroy option value.
The compact oil cooler line uses established capabilities with low holding costs, and nothing yet shows its value cannot be realized.
Enhanced tubes support efficiency gains across the exchanger portfolio at low marginal cost, so keeping the option open remains sensible despite limited direct evidence.
